newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks trade in line with close.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Stocks trade in line with close.

text.p: Stocks were trading in line with their closing prices in a quiet after-hours session, dealers said Friday.
"I don't see anything that's out of whack," said one trader. "Everything is pretty much in line."
Computer software giant Microsoft was at 115-5/8 against a Nasdaq close of 115-7/16, while computer chip maker Intel Corp was trading at the same price as its close of 155-1/8.
Netscape Communications Corp and Oracle Corp began moving after announcing they would hold a joint news conference on Monday. Netscape rose to 31 from 29-1/4 while Oracle was down at 44 from 44-3/8.
"They traded with good volumes but died down again," said another trader.
The companies declined to say what the conference would be about.
The New York Stock Exchange said Friday that session one had a volume of 1,500 shares against the previous day's 14,800 and session two had 997,349 against 983,209.
